contentList.content: The most skilled member of your party lends their experience to this check.
The whole party pitches in: companions lend their skills to checks and speak their own unique dialogue lines.
At the start of a conversation each speaker gets a bonus to skills up to the level of the best party member. The bonus is removed when the conversation ends.
Picking a lock or disarming a trap gets a Sleight of Hand bonus up to the level of the best party member.
Unique dialogue options of companions (for example Shadowheart) appear in the main character's conversations, and the companion says them.
Write skill comparisons to the Script Extender console.
